At least 8 identical ordinary symbols
anywhere on the whole board win.
Symbols do not need to touch or share a
row. All positions belong to one
board-wide count for each symbol type.
The table shows coins for ONE
qualifying symbol type at the current
total bet, using its full-board count; all
payout factors are already included. Pay
each type once, then add the awards.
WILD counts only as its own type and
does not complete other types.
SCATTER and BONUS have separate
rules.

全盘任意位置累计出现至少8个相同普通符号
即可中奖，不要求相邻或同行。每种符号在
整块棋盘上统一计数，不划分区域。
表格按同一种符号在全盘的总数，显示当前
总投注下该类型实际获得的金币，已包含赔
付系数。每种达标类型只付一次，再把各类
型奖金相加。百搭单独计数，不补足其他符
号的数量。散布和奖励符号另按对应规则。

全盤任意位置累計出現至少8個相同普通符號
即可中獎，不要求相鄰或同列。每種符號在
整塊棋盤上統一計數，不劃分區域。
表格按同一種符號在全盤的總數，顯示目前
總投注下該類型實際獲得的金幣，已包含賠
付係數。每種達標類型只付一次，再把各類
型獎金相加。百搭單獨計數，不補足其他符
號的數量。散布和獎勵符號另按對應規則。

盤面全体の任意の場所に同じ通常絵柄が合
計8個以上あれば当選です。隣接や同じ段で
ある必要はありません。絵柄ごとに盤面全
体で一つの個数として数えます。
表は盤面全体の同一シンボル数に応じて、
現在の総ベットでその種類に支払われるコ
イン数です。配当係数は計算済みです。条
件を満たす各種類に1回払い、合算します。
ワイルドは独立した種類で、他の種類の個
数を補いません。スキャッターとボーナス
は別ルールです。

전체 보드의 어느 위치든 같은 일반 기호가 총 8개
이상이면 당첨입니다. 서로 붙어 있거나 같은 행일
필요가 없습니다. 기호 종류마다 전체 보드를 하나
의 영역으로 세어 판정합니다.
표는 보드 전체의 같은 기호 수에 따라 현재 총 베
팅에서 해당 기호 종류에 지급되는 코인입니다. 배
당 계수는 이미 반영되어 있습니다. 조건을 만족하
는 종류마다 한 번 지급하여 더합니다. 와일드는 별
도 종류이며 다른 기호 수를 채우지 않습니다. 스캐
터와 보너스는 별도 규칙을 따릅니다.

Match at least 3 identical symbols on a
shown payline, starting on the leftmost
reel without a gap. Each line pays only
its highest valid result. WILD substitutes
for ordinary symbols, never SCATTER or
BONUS.
All 10 lines are active. The table shows
coins for ONE winning line at the current
total bet; all bet splits and payout factors
are already included. Add different
winning lines. Only the best result on
each line pays; shorter prefixes are not
paid again.

Each spin opens 2–4 positions on each
of 5 reels. Match the same symbol on at
least 3 consecutive reels from the
leftmost reel, in any open row. Closed
positions never participate. WILD
substitutes for ordinary symbols.
The table shows approximate coins per
winning combination at the current bet,
already using the fixed 1,024-way basis.
Multiply the unrounded value by winning
combinations, then round each symbol’s
longest-run total to whole coins. ≈ values
are shortened references, not exact
calculation inputs. Reel heights stay
fixed during this spin’s bonus; all-WILD
ways pay only as WILD.

Two independent 3 × 3 boards spin
together. Each uses 5 shown paylines.
Three identical symbols from the
leftmost reel win on a line; a line never
crosses from one board into the other.
WILD substitutes for ordinary symbols.
The total bet is split equally between the
two boards. The table already shows
coins for ONE winning line on ONE
board, including the split and payout
factor. Pay only the best result on each
line, then add both boards’ wins. Do not
divide the displayed award again.
SCATTER and BONUS follow separate
rules.
